evidence: Receiving DO2 minimum ~6.8 mg/L (t=27.6 h), far above 2.0 mg/L minimum
P assay at t=48h: 2.909 g/L, within source-batch range (2.98-3.06 g/L)
Source batches all show P rising to ~8 g/L by 72-76h and remaining ~6.4-7.0 g/L by 96h; receiving trajectory consistent with normal behavior
args.rationale: Receiving run tracks source batches closely: P at 48 h = 2.91 g/L (sources: 3.02, 3.02, 2.98), and DO2 never approached the 2 mg/L constraint (minimum ~6.8 mg/L during the 24-28 h consumption dip, recovering to ~10.8 mg/L after the feed event). No evidence of oxygen-limitation risk or product shortfall; interventions (feed reduction, air increase) would either cut substrate and risk product mass or are unnecessary since DO is not limiting. KEEP is the lowest-risk, mass-preserving choice.
args.uncertainty: Hidden receiving-process parameters could differ from source; late-run DO2 declines steadily (9.2 mg/L at 52 h) and could continue falling, but with ~7 mg/L margin above the 2 mg/L floor and a post-28h recovery precedent in sources, risk is low. No extra assay needed since product trajectory matches sources.
